:::{#rem-overfitting-causes}
#### When overfitting happens

The rme notes' [definition of overfitting](https://morrison-lab.github.io/rme/chapters/predictor-selection.html#def-overfitting)
adds that it results from including too many predictors
relative to the number of observations.
@exr-overfitting adds powers of `wt` rather than new predictors,
but each power is another coefficient fitted to the same 20 cars,
and the effect is the same.

:::
